text:
Ava Li: Quick thread on the metrics chart polish — legend behavior, axis units, smoothing defaults, and how to surface extreme spikes. Short notes.
Marcus Bell: Saw the prototype. Legend gets very noisy with 7+ series. Can we support a two-row wrap and an accessible "compact" mode that shows just icons+initials? Also need a visible focus ring for keyboard.
Rhea Kapoor: Units: prefer compact SI (k, M) on axis ticks but never single-letter units like 't'. Tooltips should always show full integer + unit (e.g., "12,345 traces"). Trim trailing zeros (12.0k -> 12k).
Jon Park: Outliers: I hit a 40x spike that flattened everything. Options tested: 1) clamp to 99th pctile with a dashed cap + badge, 2) inset minimap, 3) log scale. My vote: clamp_99 + inset, with a clickable badge that lists the clipped points.
Ava Li: Agree on clamp+inset. Important: make clipped points discoverable — marker + tooltip that says actual value and percentile (e.g., "123,456 traces (99.9th pct)").
Marcus Bell: Smoothing: add presets Raw | Trend (7). Default Raw for alert dashboards, Trend(7) for overview. If smoothing is on, overlay faint dashed raw line so peaks aren't hidden. And ensure exports always use raw data.
Design System Bot: Reminder: legend text on gray backgrounds must meet 4.5:1 contrast. Current coral token fails. Suggested coral #D75A00 (contrast 4.6:1). Also ensure series colors are color-blind safe.
Rhea Kapoor: Accessibility nits: legend items must be tabbable, arrow keys move focus, Space toggles visibility, Enter opens expand view. Announce changes via live region: "Series <name> hidden". Keep hidden series in DOM at low opacity (0.12) so screen readers can still access them.
Jon Park: UX nit: when a series is hidden, don't remove it from DOM order. Also when clipping is active show a subtle indicator on the y-axis tick where the clamp is applied.
Ava Li: Copy tweaks: change tooltip label from "count" to "traces"; legend toggle tooltip -> "Toggle series visibility"; aria-labels like "Legend item: <name>, visible".
Marcus Bell: Quick config snippet from prototype:
```
{
  "yUnit": "traces",
  "axisCompact": true,
  "tickTrimZeros": true,
  "smoothingPreset": "raw",
  "outlierStrategy": "clip_99_inset",
  "legendMode": "wrap|compact",
  "keyboardLegend": true
}
```
Rhea Kapoor: Export behavior: always export raw values. If smoothing/clipping applied in view, show a banner: "Exporting raw data. Current chart view has smoothing/clipping applied."
Ava Li: Action items: Ava update legend wrap + tokens; Marcus implement compact legend & keyboard focus; Rhea write tooltip/aria copy and export banner; Jon wire clip badge + inset panel. Reconvene Tuesday for final review. :white_check_mark:
Jon Park: I'll add unit tests for clip behavior and keyboard interactions.
Design System Bot: Deploy preview posted: https://preview.redwood-inference.com/metrics/legend-clip-1770  run NVDA/VoiceOver checks.
Ava Li: Thanks team, closing thread.
